initialize_inhouse_datastore: initialize an InhouseDatastore by calling initialize_provider_datastore with a storage path string
setup_inhouse_task_run: setup In-House provider resources for a TaskRun using setup_resources_for_task_run with args and shared state
cleanup_inhouse_task_run: cleanup temporary In-House resources from a TaskRun using cleanup_resources_from_task_run with the server URL
get_inhouse_wrapper_js: get the path to wrap_crowd_source.js for the In-House provider using the get_wrapper_js_path class method
configure_inhouse_provider_args: configure InhouseProviderArgs with ui_base_url, authorization_csv, and admit_workers_with_no_prior_qualification fields
